_comment: This manifest is populated at build time by the CI/CD pipeline. Each sha256 field must contain the lowercase hex-encoded SHA-256 hash of the corresponding file. To add a new model, append a new entry to the 'models' array with the correct modelId, version, and file hashes. Never manually edit sha256 or sizeBytes values — always derive them from the actual files using 'sha256sum' or equivalent.
